title: CI green: gofmt, golangci-lint, and unit tests all pass
essence: Accumulated formatting drift and lint violations were blocking all PR merges via CI. After applying gofmt/gofumpt sweeps, golangci-lint auto-fix, and targeted nolint suppressions, all three CI checks (gofmt, golangci-lint, unit tests) now exit 0.

checkpoints.label: unit tests (quality gate)
checkpoints.caption: go test -tags all -count=1 ./azuredevops/internal/service/release/... ./azuredevops/internal/service/taskagent/... exits 0
checkpoints.beforeNote: Unit tests could not be confirmed passing against the unformatted/unlinted tree; golangci-lint and gofmt violations blocked CI, making the build state unreliable.
checkpoints.afterNote: All 45 unit tests across 3 packages (service/release: 11, service/taskagent: 33, service/taskagent/validate: 1) pass with exit 0. No regressions introduced by the formatting and nolint fixes.

checkpoints.label: golangci-lint
checkpoints.caption: golangci-lint run -v ./azuredevops/... exits 0 — all lint errors resolved
checkpoints.beforeNote: golangci-lint reported SA1019 (deprecated API usage), wastedassign, and formatting violations across resource_release_definition.go, resource_task_group.go, and provider.go. CI was failing on every PR.
checkpoints.afterNote: golangci-lint exits 0 with no errors. SA1019 usages suppressed with //nolint:staticcheck directives where deferred by operator decision; dead assignments removed; gofmt/gofumpt formatting corrected.

checkpoints.label: gofmt / gofumpt check
checkpoints.caption: scripts/gofmtcheck.sh exits 0 — no formatting drift
checkpoints.beforeNote: scripts/gofmtcheck.sh exited non-zero; multiple .go files had formatting drift that blocked CI on every push.
checkpoints.afterNote: scripts/gofmtcheck.sh exits 0 with no diff output. All Go source files are correctly formatted per gofmt/gofumpt.
